events.cause: Interstellar distance, identity, memory, and coordination make shared infrastructure strategically valuable.

events.event: The Severance Crisis fractures Lattice access.
events.cause: Competing political and legal systems attempt incompatible control, isolation, or continuity measures.
Severed civilizations externalize the cost of lost Lattice functions onto dependent living systems.

events.event: Sol catalogued as a Lattice-adjacent high-diversity biosphere.
events.cause: Biosphere diversity, Machine stewardship, resources, and gate geography make Sol useful without making it uniquely chosen.

events.event: Gobekli Tepe monumental structures built by hunter-gatherer communities.
events.cause: Demonstrates early Human organizational and architectural sophistication without requiring nonhuman builders.

events.event: Enochic Watcher traditions develop forbidden-knowledge and angelic-descent themes.
events.cause: Provides a historical religious source layer later reinterpreted through alien-contact frameworks.

events.event: Antikythera Mechanism demonstrates sophisticated Greek astronomical computation.
events.cause: Ancient technical surprise becomes an evidentiary control against automatic alien attribution.
Ancient religious rulers later become literalized by modern alien-control interpretations.

events.event: Utsuro-bune legend recorded in Edo-period sources.
events.cause: Premodern communication-failure story later reread through UFO vocabulary.

events.event: Oahspe published as automatic-writing cosmic revelation.
events.cause: Shows elaborate heavenly bureaucracy predates modern flying-saucer contactee culture.
Witnesses interpret anomalies using contemporary technological vocabulary.
Wartime aerial uncertainty creates a recurring modern anomaly template.
Unknowns are interpreted through captured German rocket and Soviet threat models.

events.event: Flying-saucer era begins; Roswell retrieval mythology follows.
events.cause: Public anomaly vocabulary standardizes just as Cold War secrecy expands.
Dense calibrated sensing removes many easy anomalies, increasing the value of high-quality residuals.
Formal government investigation produces mixed-quality archives and unresolved residue.

events.event: Project Blue Book and early Ashtar contactee traditions grow in separate source lineages.
events.cause: Official investigation and UFO religion coexist without validating each other.
Synthetic media and incompatible exports force native-master and transformation-chain provenance.

events.event: Electrogravitics research is pursued openly by several aerospace firms, then vanishes from the public literature.
events.cause: The open phase is documented and the silence afterward is real. Whether the silence means cancellation or classification is exactly the kind of gap this setting is built in.

events.event: Project Horizon and Air Force lunar research studies.
events.cause: Real extreme Cold War planning later supplies texture to secret-space mythology.

events.event: Bracewell proposes autonomous interstellar messenger probes.
events.cause: Scientific basis for artifact SETI and long-lived autonomous probes.

events.event: Brookings delivers its NASA-commissioned study of the social implications of peaceful space activity, including possible extraterrestrial life or artifacts.
events.cause: Spaceflight made discovery-impact questions legitimate subjects for planning before any discovery existed.
Independent sensors image a manufactured object with no known launch provenance; silence prevents immediate attribution.

events.event: Strategic Air Command begins continuous Looking Glass airborne command-post operations.
events.cause: Nuclear command required survivable continuity if ground command centers were destroyed.

events.event: Operation Northwoods proposals and Starfish Prime occur in the same year.
events.cause: Real false-pretext planning and real space-environment alteration demonstrate why proposal, operation, and effect must be separated.
High-profile false positives and synthetic evidence collapse public confidence; serious anomaly work moves behind restricted programs.

events.event: Jimmy Carter reports an unidentified light seen near Leary, Georgia; the report later enters presidential-library holdings.
events.cause: A high-status witness converts an ordinary unresolved-observation problem into a durable public-disclosure reference point.

events.event: Vasin and Shcherbakov publish the speculative artificial-Moon / spaceship-Moon hypothesis.
events.cause: Apollo-era lunar discoveries create a receptive environment for technological reinterpretation of lunar anomalies.

events.event: Pellegrino Ernetti publicly advances the Chronovisor claim.
events.cause: Time-viewing, electronic voice, religious history, and Cold War technology merge into a modern retrocognition legend.
No single government can monopolize Solar observations, so rival polities agree on minimum metadata standards.

events.event: Arecibo Message; modern scripture-engineering and pseudo-ancient aviation debates.
events.cause: Human outreach and mythic engineering reinterpretation become parallel source traditions.

events.event: Tehran incident; Sitchin and Sirius ancient-contact reinterpretations published.
events.cause: Authentic case and fringe source lineages become easy to collapse online unless evidence labels remain visible.
Multi-lab work isolates a weak consciousness-linked instrument residual without validating old paranormal systems.
Broadcast, fiction, and contactee language create durable source-contamination patterns.
The residual becomes a reproducible identity-continuity channel.
Provides fictional design concepts for free will, Orion, social memory, and quarantine without becoming verified history.

events.event: Saturn's north polar hexagon is observed by Voyager and then tracked for decades by Cassini: a persistent six-sided jet stream roughly thirty thousand kilometres across that does not drift.
events.cause: A genuinely unexplained regular polygon at planetary scale. Nothing else in the solar system has corners, which is why this fiction puts the door there.
Old Weather returns a valid authentication response but no interpretable political message.
Later consciousness-farm lore merges it with unrelated alien traditions.

events.event: Ronald Reagan tells the UN that a hypothetical alien threat might make human commonality obvious.
events.cause: A rhetorical device about global unity later becomes detached from context and recycled in disclosure and false-flag narratives.
Candidate Zero answers with permissions, versioning, and revoked-authority metadata.
Independent replication establishes a non-Human technological system predating current spaceflight.
Off-world Human polities refuse Earth-wide authority over contact and artifacts.
No Human government gains accepted authority to control nonhuman infrastructure; unsanctioned expeditions accelerate.
Multi-source case strengthens Human sensor-chain methodology.
A natural distant planet is found; a separate artificial installation is identified nearby.
Humans and Old Weather disagree over salvage, custody, and successor rights.
Rival Human blocs activate the Gate before species-wide political consensus exists.

events.event: Malaysia Airlines Flight 370 disappears with 239 aboard and is never recovered.
events.cause: The disappearance itself is documented fact. A later recording purporting to show three luminous objects circling the aircraft in formation before a flash is widely assessed as fabricated, and is carried here as a CONTESTED ARTIFACT rather than evidence. Its value to this fiction is the shape of the claim: objects in a ring, then absence.
Unapproved expeditions recover mixed-origin salvage, explaining rapid pre-contact technology blending.

events.event: Oumuamua becomes first confirmed interstellar object.
events.cause: Proves extrasolar material naturally crosses the Solar System.
Humans meet refugees, traders, defectors, and post-imperial communities rather than one monolithic alien civilization.
Compact-aligned brokers privately approach Human institutions through contradictory identities and legacy claims.
The Luminous Accord becomes the first living nonhuman polity to pass planetary-scale Human provenance tests.
Human, Federation, Compact, Pirate, and Machine archives contradict one another, turning history into active politics.
Ashtar voids historic Compact claims and offers protection/Accord, triggering the Human consent crisis.

events.event: High-altitude object detections surge after radar scrutiny changes.
events.cause: Detection policy itself changes the anomaly population.

events.event: Congressional UAP hearing and NASA independent study.
events.cause: Public allegations and scientific data-quality standards become competing disclosure narratives.
Dormant Compact dependencies activate across legal, genetic, economic, religious, and technical systems.
Official review documents claim history while reporting no verified hidden extraterrestrial reverse-engineering evidence.
Liberation reveals client populations may biologically or infrastructurally depend on the systems being dismantled.

events.event: 3I/ATLAS identified as third known interstellar object.
events.cause: Provides a natural interstellar control case.
Federation transit restrictions block renewed extraction but are perceived by Humans as external rule.

events.event: UAP archives and public provenance databases expand.
events.cause: Versioned records make later Archive War analysis possible.
Smugglers, refugee fleets, route pilots, and sanctuary ports become a coherent nonterritorial Pirate polity.
Machine mission spreads beyond Sol and divergent copies demand political personhood while Vigil routines remain neutral.

events.event: Apophis is intercepted and broken. The rock is hollow and crewed: a delivery vehicle of Extraction Compact stock and maker-format units, which the intercept scatters intact across half a planet instead of burning on entry. The Federation of Light had ruled the object a natural event and declined to divert it, and so never looked inside it.
events.cause: The public record of a safe pass is preserved as the cover story; the timing residual is the tell.
events.superseded_text: Apophis safely passes Earth; fiction preserves a tiny timing residual.

events.cause: All five conquest systems become simultaneously scalable across reactivated Source-Lattice pentads.

events.event: The hexagon is entered and found to be an aperture: six emitters held in circular phase, twisting local spacetime until separation across the opening falls to zero.
events.cause: Reverse engineering it shows the principle is general and the scale is not fixed. A ring of oscillators spun up in formation opens a seamless passage for as long as it is held, which is the mechanism the contested 2014 artifact appears to describe in miniature.
